label: Claude Haiku 5.5
output:
To: @renee.whitlock
Replying to: s01
Cc: none
Subject: none

Hey Renee, here's the rundown for Monday.

Friday we beat Brookhollow 31-14 at home and locked up 2nd in the region. Tavion Hurst had 188 yards rushing and 2 TDs, including a long one in the 3rd. Our line pushed them back 5 yards on that whole drive, best I've seen them block all year. Deshawn Pettaway had 3 sacks and 7 tackles. The kids voted him defensive player of the week in the locker room before the coaches even met. Defense held them to 46 yards rushing in the second half.

We got a HOME playoff game. First round is Friday Nov 13, 7pm at Ridge Field vs Clanton Valley. Would love for Dr. Pruitt to know that and for folks to come out. Presale starts Tuesday. We need gate and chain crew confirmed by Wednesday.

9-week grade check is in and all 52 kids on the roster are eligible, nobody on the list. Give Tonya Greer the credit on that one. Her Tuesday and Thursday study hall is the reason, and she's keeping it going through the playoffs.

Boston butt sale final count is 208 sold, $6,240 raised against a $4,500 goal. Money goes toward the new sideline headsets. Huge thanks to Hargrove's Meat Market for smoking at cost. Gene's got a concessions sign-up going out for the playoff game.

If we win and go on the road, I'll get you the bus requests right after.

Thanks,
Coach T
